research.title: Robustness Evaluation for Object Detection Under Image Degradation
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing object detectors under motion blur, sensor noise, and compression artifacts while holding training data and evaluation splits fixed.
Analyzed detection errors by object size and corruption severity, separating localization failures from classification errors to assess sensitivity to image degradation.

research.title: Cross-Domain Evaluation of Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Designed experiments comparing segmentation models across daylight and nighttime street imagery, controlling augmentation settings and training schedules to isolate domain effects.
Analyzed classwise overlap scores and boundary errors, examining whether illumination changes disproportionately affected small objects and visually similar foreground categories.

research.title: Calibration of Image Classifiers with Limited Training Data
bullets: Designed experiments varying training subset size and label imbalance to evaluate confidence calibration in convolutional image classifiers using held-out validation data.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, calibration error, and classification accuracy before and after temperature scaling, distinguishing aggregate trends from minority-class confidence patterns.

publications.title: Confidence Calibration in Data-Limited Image Classification: Effects of Class Imbalance and Temperature Scaling

work.title: Image Ingestion and Validation Utilities
bullets: Implemented assigned image ingestion components that checked file formats, normalized metadata, and routed malformed uploads through existing application error handling.
Added regression tests for decoding failures and duplicate submissions, and investigated processing defects using application logs and reproducible image fixtures.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Local Feature Matching
bullets: Implemented image matching pipelines using SIFT and ORB descriptors with nearest-neighbor matching and robust homography estimation on paired scene images.
Compared matching precision and geometric alignment under rotation, scale changes, and partial occlusion, documenting failure cases associated with repetitive textures.

projects.title: Transfer Learning Strategies for Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen-feature classification and partial fine-tuning of a pretrained convolutional network, using identical data partitions and preprocessing for comparative evaluation.
Compared validation accuracy, training behavior, and classwise confusion across adaptation settings, examining sensitivity to augmentation choices and the extent of layer freezing.
